found_values.value: Yes: the pack must charge while R5's 3.0 V floor disconnect is open, because USB-C is the only charge source (F8) and R5's disconnect, the R5460N212AF (F version), releases only after a charger is connected and the cell rises above the released voltage (R5 V93, V94). The charger need not sit on the cells' side of it: on over-discharge the R5460 turns off only the discharge FET (DOUT 'L'); COUT stays 'H', so a charger on the board side charges the cells through the charge FET and the discharge FET's parasitic diode. The BQ25713 charges only after a host write (ChargeCurrent resets to 0, 175 s watchdog): the RP2354B runs from VSYS on USB-C (V152), which the disconnect does not cut when it sits between the cells and the charger's battery node. Below 6.144 V the charge is clamped to 384 mA.
